content: To create a microchaptered page, follow these detailed instructions: Searching for the Page You Want to Create 1. Begin by searching for the disease name of the page you intend to create. 2. Additionally, search for synonyms or alternative names of the disease to avoid duplicating content. 3. If the page already exists but is not microchaptered, you may create a new microchaptered page for the disease. Afterward, reorganize the existing content into the microchaptered format. 4. Only proceed with microchaptering if the page exceeds one-and-a-half pages in length and contains, or is expected to contain, sufficient content to justify microchapters. 5. To microchapter an existing page, follow the instructions for creating a microchapter template. Copy and paste the reorganized content into the standardized microchapter structure. Creating a Microchapter Template 1. If the disease page does not exist, you will need to create a new microchaptered page. For example, if you are creating a page on jaundice, follow these steps: 2. Navigate to the WikiDoc Disease Microchapter Template page. 3. Click on the edit source tab and copy all the text in the edit box. 4. In the main WikiDoc search box, type Template:Jaundice (without quotation marks). 5. Click on the link that says Create the page Template:Jaundice on this Wiki. 6. In the new page, click on the edit source tab and paste the copied microchapter template into the edit box. 7. At the top of the edit box, you will see two blank fields: The top field, marked with binocular icons, should contain type page name here. The bottom field, marked with red arrows, should contain the name of the disease (e.g., Jaundice). 8. Click the red arrows on the right side of the bottom field repeatedly until the disease name is inserted into all the microchapter navigation boxes. 9. Remove any cells in the template that are not relevant to the disease you are working on. 10. Click save at the bottom of the edit box. 11. You now have a microchapter navigation template that can be used in all subsequent microchapter pages for the disease. Creating the Microchaptered Home Page 1. Search for the disease name in the WikiDoc search box. 2. For example, if creating a page for jaundice: Search for Jaundice and click on the link that says Create the page Jaundice on this Wiki. In the edit box, type `{{Jaundice}}`. Click save at the bottom of the edit box. The main page will now display the microchapters on the right side. 3. Use the microchapter template for all subsequent microchapter pages by typing `{{Jaundice}}` into the edit box of each page. 4. The home page should also include links to the individual microchapter pages in the correct order. To do this, type the following format into the edit box: ``` [[PageName|DisplayName]] ``` On the left side of the vertical line is the link to the page, and on the right side is how the link will appear on the home page. For example, the link might appear as Historical Perspective on the home page. 5. Use the template provided on the WikiDoc Disease Microchapter Template page: Copy the template information from the edit box. Paste it into the home page of the microchapter you are creating. Use the search-and-replace function to replace Type page name here with the name of the disease (e.g., Jaundice). Click the red button to replace the terms. 6. Remove any links that are not relevant to the disease. 7. Note that while the microchapter pages use lowercase headings, the links on the home page may appear differently. Maintain consistency in capitalization and nomenclature. Creating Individual Pages Within a Microchaptered Page 1. The home page will display the microchapter navigation template on the right side of the screen. The headings of the microchapters will appear in the middle section of the page, linking to the respective microchapters. 2. To practice navigating a microchaptered page, refer to an example home page. 3. As you create new microchapter pages, add links to them on the home page. 4. To create a new microchapter page: Click on the appropriate section within the microchapter navigation template on the home page. Click on the link that says Create the page _____ on this Wiki. Use the appropriate template listed on the main page to create the new page. Include the microchapter navigation template (e.g., `{{Jaundice}}`) on each microchapter page. References and Sources 1. If the content for the page is derived from general sources, such as textbooks or websites, list them under a heading titled Sources at the bottom of the page. 2. If the content is obtained from journal articles or other scholarly articles, list them under a heading titled References at the bottom of the page.
